name: Button
purpose: Triggers an action or navigates to a destination when pressed by the user.
neverUseFor: Pure navigation between pages — use a plain <a>, styled separately
Toggle state that persists — use a Toggle or Checkbox instead
Submitting a form implicitly — always set type='submit' explicitly
rationale: Button sizes were consolidated to 's', 'm', 'l' (ADR-004) to avoid fragmented UI scales. The loading state retains button dimensions to prevent layout shift. Icons are fixed size to maintain touch target alignment and visual weight.

mayExtendLocally: Compose with custom tooltips or popover wrappers in product apps
Pass custom aria-label or data-testid attributes
mustEscalateToDS: Overriding internal padding tokens or height tokens directly

authored.name: loading
authored.description: The action triggered by the button is in progress. The button is non-interactive and shows a spinner.

authored.name: disabled
authored.description: The button is not interactive. Communicates the option exists but is currently unavailable. Solid gray via dedicated fill/text/icon/border.disabled tokens, never opacity — see .ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md.

anatomy.description: Root interactive element. Always a native <button>.
Leading icon slot. Accepts a Tabler icon component.
Loading spinner. Rendered only when loading=true.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button. primary = filled brand; secondary = outlined; ghost = no border; danger = filled red.

props.name: size
props.description: Physical size of the button. Affects padding, font size, and icon size. 'm' is the default and the size used absent a specific reason to deviate — xs/xl were removed 2026-08-23 (too narrow a use case to justify a 5-rung scale).

props.name: isLoading
props.description: When true, shows a spinner and disables interaction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, the button is non-interactive.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, passed by reference (not pre-instantiated). Always rendered via the Icon component at size=16 (stroke scales automatically), regardless of button size — aria-hidden is set automatically.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Trailing icon. Same fixed size=16 as icon.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: When true, the button expands to 100% of its container width.

props.name: children
props.description: The button's text (rendered in button-label). Never a `label` prop — Button takes its text as children; an icon-only action is IconButton.

height.note: Set by size token —  never override manually.

modes.hug: Width shrinks to content + horizontal padding. Default behavior.
modes.fill: Width expands to 100% of container. Activated by fullWidth=true.
modes.fixed: Explicit value set by the consumer. No system token — document per usage.

width.note: No min/max-width tokens defined in CSS. Consumers are responsible for constraining width in layouts.
